text:
jorge: Hey team, dashboards for org=acme-corp are showing empty panels and the network tab shows 500s from /v1/analytics/query. Started ~09:04 UTC, affects multiple dashboards. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/abc123. This is blocking ops.

maya: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the panel id(s) and the org id? Any console errors? Browser?

jorge: panel ids: 42, 43, 89. org: acme-corp (org_4321). No console errors besides the 500 response. Chrome 119. Happening in US-WEST only it seems.

sam: Thanks @jorge — collecting details. Can you try a direct curl to the analytics API and paste the response body / headers? Also HAR would help if easy.

jorge: here's a quick curl I ran from our terminal (same region):

```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/analytics/query' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"org":"acme-corp","panel_id":42,"from":"2026-03-16T08:50:00Z","to":"2026-03-16T09:10:00Z","interval":"auto"}'

# Response: 500 Internal Server Error
# Body: {"error":"clickhouse: query timeout exceeded","trace_id":"tr_0a1b2c3d4e"}
```

analytics-bot: ALERT: analytics-query latency spike starting 2026-03-16T09:03:12Z — 500 rate 18% over 5m window. Related traces: tr_0a1b2c3d4e, tr_4f5g6h7i8j.

evan: I'm on it. Correlating traces — I see a deploy of analytics-optimizer v3.2.0 at 09:01 UTC. ClickHouse queries for auto-interval are exploding because the optimizer selected a per-second rollup for long ranges, causing huge GROUP BY cardinality. Logs:

```
2026-03-16T09:03:14Z ERROR analytics-aggregator - query_id=tr_0a1b2c3d4e - clickhouse error: Code: 60, e.displayText() = DB::Exception: Timeout exceeded while reading from socket (version 23.4.7.43)
2026-03-16T09:03:15Z WARN autoscaler - pending queue len 47, avg latency 1.2s
```

maya: Is this limited to US-WEST? Jorge said only that region.

evan: Yeah, looks region-specific — US-WEST cluster's ClickHouse replica got a bad plan. Workarounds: 1) set interval explicitly to 1m or 5m instead of auto, 2) hit /v1/analytics/rollup (pre-aggregated) endpoint for those panels, 3) temporary increase ClickHouse query timeout and scale replicas.

priya: For frontend, we can also fall back to cached snapshot for that dashboard for 30m if we detect 5xxs. But need a backend fix asap.

evan: I'll push a hotfix to analytics-aggregator to cap the auto-interval based on time window and force a 1m rollup for windows >6h. Steps I'll run now:
- revert the optimizer flag introduced in v3.2.0
- redeploy analytics-aggregator US-WEST
- monitor 5xx rate

k8s-deploy-bot: redeploy started for analytics-aggregator/us-west, rollout id rr-20260316-09-4. Pods terminating -> new pods starting.

evan: rolling restart done, new pods are healthy. Increasing ClickHouse timeout as a short-term safety net.

k8s-deploy-bot: rollout rr-20260316-09-4 completed (3/3 pods ready)

jorge: Confirmed — panels are loading again for acme-corp. No more 500s. Thanks!

maya: marking as resolved on our side. Follow-ups: create a regression test for auto-interval behavior and add a dashboard-level fallback to cached snapshot on 5xx. Priya to file a frontend PR for snapshot fallback.

sam: I'll send a postmortem to the customer and update the incident ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
